title: Are Large Language Models Really Good Logical Reasoners? A Comprehensive Evaluation and Beyond
reasoning: The paper primarily focuses on evaluating the logical reasoning capabilities of LLMs. While 'ethics' is mentioned in the 'Future Directions' section, it is in the context of increasing explainability for sensitive applications involving ethics, privacy, and health, rather than a direct evaluation or benchmarking of the LLMs' inherent moral, ethical, or faith-based reasoning abilities within the scope of this paper.
